patterns.note: Full-bleed hero and key section background images are used, often with content cards or text overlays positioned centrally or to one side, creating a layered effect.
A strong two-tone background system alternates between clean white and a deep forest green to clearly delineate major content blocks and sections.
The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground content card, adding depth to the initial view.
Impact metrics and goals are presented in a four-column grid, each with a large number, an icon, and descriptive text, set against a distinct background color.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the overlaying content card, creating a subtle parallax depth effect. Other elements likely use CSS keyframe animations for gentle fade-in or slide-up reveals as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery.

Content is frequently presented within distinct cards, often with a white background, which are sometimes overlaid on full-bleed background images or placed within multi-column grids to organize information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are moderately sized and often bold, with a clear hierarchy that supports readability without being overly dramatic, complemented by legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (small corner radius on buttons and cards)
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within content blocks, creating an airy feel, but tighter within card grids.

standout: The site effectively uses full-bleed, high-quality nature photography as a primary design element, often serving as a background for overlaid content cards, which creates a strong emotional connection and a sense of immersion. The consistent use of a deep forest green alongside white provides a distinct, natural brand identity.
